card.name: Linking words in PML and MS drug warnings
card.fires_on: Small linking words and punctuation (including, with, commas, open parenthesis, of, in) right after a drug or condition name in warnings, especially about PML and MS drugs. Also fires partway through drug names like cyclophosphamide.

modes.label: Link after PML or MS drug
modes.description: A word like including, with or a comma follows PML, MS treatment or a drug such as fingolimod.
modes.example: MS medications associated with PML,<< including>> fingolimod capsules.

modes.label: Link before a measure or lab term
modes.description: A small word or bracket leads into a lab change, kidney value or concentration.
modes.example: Moderate or severe renal impairment<< (>>CrCl≤50 mL/min)

modes.label: Inside a drug name
modes.description: The pole fires partway through a long immunosuppressant name.

card.plain: It fires on small connecting words in warnings about MS drugs, PML and kidney or lab changes.
